name: Fraser and Company Limited
summary: Fraser and Company Limited, established in 1917 and headquartered in Mumbai, India, operates as a diversified trading firm. The company functions as general merchants, deals in various goods and commodities, and serves as commission, buying, and selling agents. It also engages extensively in international trade, importing and exporting a range of retail products. Its offerings include a variety of textile and allied materials such as silk, cotton, acrylic, velvet, and other dress materials. Furthermore, the company is actively involved in the global diamond market, handling both their import and export.
